defaultTitle: Lanza (beta): own your presence on the web
defaultDescription: Most people rent their voice from social media and own nothing. Lanza gives you a real site you own outright, free on GitHub and Cloudflare, with no database or server to hack, edited by talking to ChatGPT or Claude. You keep a copy of everything, so you can always leave. In beta and running in public. The anti-WordPress CMS.
